{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Yithræl''''' was the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] term for pride honor, that is, the honor of the clan. If a Sakiyan [[Gender/Legends|male]] failed to provide [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for his mate and [[Youngling/Legends|children]], his failure was considered a stain against his pride's ''yithræl''.

Similar to ''[[monthræl]]'', the terms referred to different types of honor.
